highlights: Result Update 06th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 1,525 UNO Minda Ltd Auto Ancillary 1 Capacity Expansion & Technology-Led Growth Drive Outlook Est.
Switches, Lighting, Casting, Seating, Green Mobility and Other Products registered strong YoY growth of 37%, 25%, 57%, 34%, 102% and 17%, respectively.

The Green Mobility segment contributed Rs 649 Cr (10% of consolidated revenue), led by EV Systems (Rs 247 Cr), Alternate Fuel Systems (Rs 187 Cr), Auto Innovation (Rs 156 Cr) and EV Controllers (Rs 44 Cr), reflecting rising EV penetration and increasing share of business with existing and new customers.
Management retained FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 11.0% (±50 bps), with commodity costs passed on to customers on a back-to-back basis.
